logicalGuarantee: No source object is adopted or displayed; only approved Team-owned association can confer authority. Branding stays denied until separately reviewed ownership/epoch/authorization decision.
physicalGuarantee: NONE: admitted requests may complete late; no lifetime inferred from expiry or observation

window.onGap: Hold acceptance/stop progression; do not classify silence as absence
window.afterWindow: Source prefix remains quarantined and unconsumed; named custodian continues review. No claim that physical arrivals end at window boundary.

unversionedLimitation: Current bucket has no versioning. Lists cannot recover overwritten/deleted historical bodies or certify all arrivals. Complete arrival history requires separately installed/verified data-event coverage; delivery has no assumed bounded completeness certificate.
requiredAuditExecutionReview: Inspect account-local EDS create/query/export IAM and any service-linked-role prerequisite; no silent IAM grant
Confirm provider schema/template, event-data-store quota, account selector/retention/cost and exact region

No organization-level selector change, shared bucket notification/versioning change or runtime permission change
Preserve/export sanitized receipts before separately approved stop/delete; seven-day retention does not authorize evidence loss

originalPrincipalProof.generated: Actual Cognito-authenticated contradictory generated mutations exercise existing AppSync data-source roles after fence; correlate service reaching and actual role.
originalPrincipalProof.manual: Exact existing approved operator guarded diagnostic calls with actual principal/request correlation.
originalPrincipalProof.shared: Original service role cannot be assumed by user. Gateway maintenance denial is not data-plane proof; original handler lacks a guaranteed non-mutating diagnostic branch. Requires separate security-owned original-principal method, not restricted-role substitution.
originalPrincipalProof.cleanup: Never invoke teardown or reuse cleanup role. Bucket-policy administration grant remains documented. Original-principal execution has no approved safe path; separate security decision required.

requiredBeforeMaintenance: Verified complete logo write-event audit/correlation, or a separately reviewed weaker criterion that is NOT called complete arrival history
